feat: Solaris v0.0.8 — core v2 server, native storage, entity layout

Replace the v1 server with core v2 (`solaris-v2`): one native tick with
parallel snapshot reads, owned intents and a deterministic serial merge;
native store plus tick WAL, offline Anvil import/export (ADR 0013/0014).
The v1 crates mc-server, mc-net, mc-simulation and mc-entity are removed.

Gameplay since v0.0.7 includes Nether/End and the dragon fight, special
mobs, mounts and vehicles, wave 3 mechanics (sculk/warden, trial chambers,
mace, crafter, copper, bees/allay, raids, conduits), statistics,
advancements, scoreboards, piglin bartering, armor stands, fishing,
player-built iron/snow golems, elytra gliding and beacons. PlayerCommand
actions follow the 26.1.2 seven-entry enum.

Entity layout (committee decision 013): rare components boxed, sorted type
lanes instead of full-row scans, and a dense single-owner Body column.
fp native-100 rises from 14.5 to 15.9 TPS and RSS drops by 415 MiB.

Wasmtime plugin packages load from [plugins].directory; the manifest
parser accepts inventory_storage_transactions. CI pins the rebuilt
sibling loader and plugin revisions.

Vanilla loot, enchantment and light tables load at runtime from the
imported content cache (CoreRegistry); Mojang data is no longer compiled
into the binary. CI extracts local test data from the verified server jar.

feat(protocol)!: serve Minecraft Java 26.3 (protocol 777)

Canonical release moves from 26.1.2/775 to 26.3/777 (world version 5023).

Protocol (mc-protocol, mc-edge):
- every play/configuration packet id from the 26.3 packets report;
  LoginSuccess session id, LoginPlay online_mode, spawn-info varint game mode
- 26.3 layouts: EntityPositionSync linear PositionPath, move-entity varint
  props, rot packet field order, EntityAnimation {wake, crit, magic crit},
  new ClientboundSwingAnimation, AcceptTeleportation carries the accepted
  pose (folded into a movement input like vanilla), Swing -> Punch,
  PlayerAction ChangeDestroyDirection, sign update order, team parameters,
  advancement display, sweep particle, explode play_sound, particle ids
- component wire ids are named consts (mc_data::data_component_types_26_1_2)
  instead of bare numbers; pot_decorations is 4 optional item templates

Data (mc-data): 26.3 blocks/items/entity types, collision and outline shape
tables, entity contract (cushion, poplar boats, sulfur cube; bee size, hoglin
peaceful flag), block entity kinds (bed removed, potent_sulfur), custom stat
sleep_in_straw_bed, sculk tags, wire registry index (new biome, damage type,
jukebox song). Persisted player statistics now name their registry release;
26.1.2 records migrate by name via embedded 26.1.2 id tables.

Content: 26.3 rewrote the loot/predicate and worldgen data-pack grammars, so a
cache joins the 26.3 bundle (version.json, reports, extractor reports,
captured RegistryData) with the 26.1.2 gameplay data pack
(gameplay_version.json). `content import --from <26.3> --gameplay-from
<26.1.2>` (or --download for both); wire registries list the captured payloads
and the 26.1.2 definitions must name a subset of them.
